title: Azores as sunken mountain tops of a lost Mid-Atlantic land

tellings.quote: we're seeing now, those islands are the tops of mountains, sunk in mountains.

plain: The Azores, the islands in the middle of the Atlantic, are the tops of mountains of a land that has sunk, according to the researcher Randall Carlson. He tells Michels "those islands are the tops of mountains, sunk in mountains" as his own reading, without naming a source, on an episode about ancient catastrophes. If true, a sizeable landmass once stood above the sea in the mid-Atlantic.
